query:
UPDATE rules.rules r
                 SET kind_id       = rk.id,
                     value         = $3,
                     action_id     = ra.id,
                     text          = $5,
                     trigger_token = $6,
                     inject_text   = $7,
                     enabled       = $8,
                     source_id     = rs.id,
                     updated_at    = $10,
                     project_path  = $11,
                     sort_order    = $12,
                     style_override = $13,
                     title         = $14
                FROM rules.kinds   rk,
                     rules.actions ra,
                     rules.sources rs
                WHERE rk.code = $2
                  AND ra.code = $4
                  AND rs.code = $9
                  AND r.id    = $1
